longDescription:
This package is a personal full text search package is based on a very strong backend (Xapian), for which it provides an easy to use and feature-rich interface.

Features: * Qt-based GUI * Supports the following document types (and their compressed versions) - Natively: text, html, OpenOffice files, maildir and mailbox (Mozilla and IceDove mail) with attachments, pidgin log files - With external helpers: pdf (pdftotext), postscript (ghostscript), msword (antiword), excel, ppt (catdoc), rtf (unrtf) * Powerful query facilities, with boolean searches, phrases, filter on file types and directory tree * Support for multiple charsets, Internal processing and storage uses Unicode UTF-8 * Stemming performed at query time (can switch stemming language after indexing) * Easy installation. No database daemon, web server or exotic language necessary * An indexer which runs either as a thread inside the GUI or as an external, cron'able program
